Control Objective: Grant access based on approved business need and least privilege.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.5.15 Access control; A.5.18 Access rights
Evidence Needed: User/role export, access policy, approved access requests, periodic review records

Control Objective: Require strong authentication for privileged and remote access.
Evidence Needed: MFA policy, identity-provider configuration, privileged-account coverage report

Control Objective: Separate trust zones and restrict unnecessary network paths.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.8.20 Network security; A.8.22 Segregation of networks
Evidence Needed: Current network diagram, security-group/firewall rules, rule review evidence

Control Objective: Identify, prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities within approved timeframes.
Evidence Needed: Latest scan, severity definitions, patch SLA, remediation and exception records

Control Objective: Generate, protect, retain and review relevant security logs.
Evidence Needed: Log-source inventory, retention configuration, alert samples, review records

Control Objective: Maintain and test backups and recovery capability against business objectives.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.8.13 Information backup; A.5.30 ICT readiness for business continuity
Evidence Needed: Backup policy, restore test results, approved RTO/RPO and exceptions

Control Objective: Assess supplier risk before onboarding and monitor material changes.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.5.19-A.5.23 supplier and cloud-service security controls
Evidence Needed: Vendor inventory, due diligence, assurance reports, contract clauses, review dates

Control Objective: Integrate security review and testing into development and release processes.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.8.25 Secure development life cycle; A.8.29 Security testing in development and acceptance
Evidence Needed: Pipeline configuration, code-review records, scan results, exception approvals

Control Objective: Prevent disclosure of secrets and manage their lifecycle securely.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.8.24 Use of cryptography (confirm applicability to the control design)
Evidence Needed: Secret-scanning output, secrets-manager configuration, rotation records, access policy

Control Objective: Prepare, exercise and improve incident management procedures.
Evidence Needed: Response plan, playbooks, exercise record, lessons learned and action tracking

Control Objective: Classify information and define handling requirements appropriate to sensitivity.
ISO 27001:2022 Reference: A.5.12 Classification of information; A.5.13 Labelling of information
Evidence Needed: Approved classification standard, data inventory, sample handling decisions

Control Objective: Maintain secure configuration baselines and identify unauthorized drift.
Evidence Needed: Approved baseline, drift reports, change tickets and exception records
